in_marathi.name: Pl
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus or Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pl हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Padma', meaning lotus. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a symbol of creation and purity. It is also a symbol of detachment, as it grows in water but its roots are in the mud at the bottom. The name Pl can also mean 'light', which symbolizes knowledge, wisdom, and illumination.
